summary: HIVE Digital Technologies filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing a strategic commercial partnership, not a special situation. On September 10, 2026, wholly owned subsidiary BUZZ High Performance Computing entered a partnership with Vancouver-based ProCogia; ProCogia will procure dedicated GPU capacity from BUZZ HPC's Canadian data centers, and ProCogia becomes preferred applied-AI services partner, with joint marketing in the U.S. and Europe. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated. Watch execution risk and future revenue contribution disclosures.
